mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO media_attachment (target_type, target_id, type, object_key, url, original_name, sort_order) VALUES
(#{item.targetType}, #{item.targetId}, #{item.type}, #{item.objectKey}, #{item.url}, #{item.originalName}, #{item.sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.target_type, a.target_id, a.type, a.kind, a.registered, a.registered_by, a.object_key, a.url, a.original_name, l.display_order AS sort_order, a.created_at FROM event_attachment_link l JOIN media_attachment a ON a.id = l.attachment_id WHERE l.target_type = #{targetType} AND l.target_id = #{targetId} ORDER BY l.display_order, a.id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM event_attachment_link WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_attachment_link (target_type, target_id, attachment_id, display_order) VALUES (#{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{attachmentId}, #{displayOrder})
